label: EPISTEMIC_IDENTIFICATION_4: Identifies agent bearer quality represents the agent identifying the…
definition: Identifies agent bearer quality represents the agent identifying the bearer as F. This is separate from being F, participating, grounding and production. No infallibility, evidence or knowledge axiom is included.
note: Modern analytical test vocabulary for issue #260. The primary passages motivate the question, not these formal definitions. A sourced replacement would require a passage specifying these precise relations and restrictions.
